*(Mine and tentative: "…the fortresses at once, for the pious Divodāsa, [and] Śambara; and then that Turvaśa and Yadu".)*
that king rules over the peoples; like a rim [round] spokes, he has encompassed all these (mine, tentative)
he encompassed all the poetic works as a rim a wheel (mine, tentative)
Agni, as a rim [round] spokes, you encompass the gods (mine, tentative)
— mine and tentative: "The Manus, with Agni as their tongue, with the sun as their eye — may all the gods come here to us for our protection."
— mine and tentative: "I declare this praise to heaven and earth; may the tender-bellied (? *ṛdūdarāḥ*, reading [?]) ones, tongued with Agni, hear."
— mine and tentative: "the twice-born ones, who are keepers of the rite, the true, the heaven-possessing, the worshipful, tongued with Agni."
— mine and tentative: "You who are tongued with Agni, or who are worshipful: sitting down on this grass, rejoice."
— mine and tentative: "the many, sun-eyed, fire-tongued increasers of the rite."
— mine and tentative: "the heaven-dwelling (? *divakṣasaḥ*), fire-tongued increasers of the rite sit, touching (considering) the womb of the rite."
— mine and tentative: "Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, good leaders; heaven and earth, the earth, the middle region."
— mine and tentative: "I call here the Aśvins, Mitra and Varuṇa, and Bhaga, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas."
— mine and tentative: "of the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudriyas — the god does not diminish the abode of the gods."
— mine and tentative: "We call the gods, the Ādityas, for help, the Vasus, the Rudras, Savitṛ of good works."
— mine and tentative: "Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, good givers, quicken these prayers as they are recited."
— mine and tentative: "I move with the Rudras, with the Vasus; I with the Ādityas and with the All-gods."
— mine and tentative: "Come to us with the Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus; come to us for our well-being."

— mine and tentative: "Agni, in company with the Vasus bring us Indra; with the Rudras, the great Rudra; with the Ādityas, Aditi, kind to all people; and Bṛhaspati, all-choosing, with the praisers (*ṛkvabhiḥ*)."

— mine and tentative: "May Indra with the Vasus protect our household; may Aditi with the Ādityas give us shelter; may the god Rudra with the Rudras make us happy; may Tvaṣṭṛ with the goddesses speed us to well-being."

— mine and tentative: "Because they (the Vasus) cover/abide in all, Agni with the Vasus — the name 'Vāsava' — therefore they have the earth as their place; Indra with the Vasus — the name 'Vāsava' — therefore they have the middle region as their place; the Vasus are the rays of the Sun, from their shining forth/pervading, therefore they have the heaven as their place."
— mine and tentative: "O gods, we have made easy your going and good your path, you who have come, delighting in this pressing; having eaten and drunk, all of you, O Vasus, put riches in us."
— mine and tentative: "Dadhyañc, the earlier Aṅgiras, Priyamedha, Kaṇva, Atri, Manu knew my birth; those ancestors of mine, Manu, knew."
— mine and tentative: "As you two helped Kaṇva, (and) Priyamedha, who was praised …"
— mine and tentative: "O much-praised one, may the two bays praised by Priyamedha (bring) you hither."
— mine and tentative: "The Priyamedhas, makers of great (deeds), called (Agni) for help."
— mine and tentative: "The people exalted Indra with praises; the Priyamedhas sang."
— mine and tentative: "The Priyamedhas called you two (to come) with all (your) helps."
— mine and tentative: "Sing, sing forth, Priyamedhas, sing."
— mine and tentative: "Like birds, like eagles, the Priyamedha seers sat down by Indra, begging."

— mine and tentative: "With the oblation (or: water) the dryer-up of the waters fills (*pipartti*); *papuḥ*: (these are) Vedic words from *pṛ* 'to fill' or *prī* 'to please'; the father, the observer of what is done, Āditya."
— mine and tentative: "*aktubhiḥ* (means) by the nights."
*(Mine, tentative: "Whatever may be fallen from letter or word, or wanting in measure — may all that be forgiven, O God, Lord of Speech; homage to you. May it be well. Auspiciousness.")*
